summary: Dynex Capital, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 25, 2026, reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 22, 2026, under which it will issue and sell 4,800,000 shares of 9.375% Series D Fixed-Rate Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock, par value $0.01 per share, at a $25.00 liquidation preference in an underwritten public offering. The underwriters, led by Morgan Stanley, J.P. Morgan, RBC, UBS, Wells Fargo, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, and Keefe Bruyette & Woods, were granted a 30-day option for up to 720,000 additional shares. Expected net proceeds are approximately $116,220,000 before expenses, with closing expected on or about September 29, 2026. The offering was made under an automatic shelf registration statement. The filing does not include a board recommendation or financial advisor. Watch for pricing, over-allotment exercise, and market reception to the new preferred issuance.
